label: Late original-phase positions (t=4-7), strongest right after w (also 0, c, q)
explanation: Fires almost only in the original input phase at positions t=4-7: that window holds 99% of activation mass, peaking at t=5-6. It never fires at t<=3 or in the copy phase, and only weakly at the delimiter. Within the window the previous input token sets both the rate and the magnitude. After w the rate is 17% (8.6x lift), and prev_tok=w covers 47% of the top-quartile activations. 0, c and q give weaker boosts (about 3x). Top examples are mostly ...w [X] with high-magnitude activation on the token right after w, often in sequences that start with h/i. The position window alone has recall 0.99 but precision 0.11. Adding the previous-token condition raises precision to 0.38 at recall 0.47, so most low-magnitude activations are spread diffusely across the window and are not captured.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: prev_tok=w (+6.04), orig2=i (+3.72), orig1=i (+3.24), orig2=h (+2.87), orig1=h (+2.80), prev2_tok=w (+2.77). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-9.90), orig_idx=-1 (-6.65), t=3 (-5.86), phase=2 (-5.53).
